column7: Drawn illustration, comic book line art: clean black contour outlines, flat colour areas, shading in a few hard cel steps. Night interior seen from a low angle across a dark wooden desk. In the FOREGROUND, filling the lower half of the frame, a thick CLOSED spiral notebook lies flat on the desk, seen slightly from above: its plain front cover faces us, bare cardstock, completely empty and unwritten, and the black wire coil runs along the LEFT edge of the cover, as it does on a closed notebook. The cover is CLEAN: no pencil, no objects, nothing lying on top of it. A pencil rests on the desk BESIDE the notebook, at its right, on the wood. In the BACKGROUND, behind and above the notebook, an old arcade cabinet stands in the dark, its CRT screen still switched on and glowing bright pale blue-green, throwing cold light onto the top edge of the notebook; the screen shows only soft abstract blocks of light, nothing readable. A warm desk lamp at the right is dim, so the cold screen light and a little warm spill from the right edge are the only light. The LOWER LEFT corner of the frame falls into deep shadow. Generous empty cover across the middle of the notebook. Flat colour, cel shading in two tones, black outlines.
